usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and sinao keeps the books, with “Create or Edit an Invoice” adjusting the invoice.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create or Edit an Invoice” in sinao
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order changes what you bill, so the invoice is edited to match.

watchOut: “Create or Edit an Invoice” takes an amount in TTC or HT, so check which one you map.
